translation: Took place in posad Serock, (30 July) the thirtieth of July 1890, 8 PM. Appeared personally Abram Moszek Rozenowicz, keeper of a lodging house, 56, and Lejzor Wielkobroda, painter, 34, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 11 AM in posad Serock died a child without a name, of the surname Winogura, of female sex, aged three days. Its father is Lejb Winogura and mother Chaja Rakla. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
